ABOUT US

MAI KỲ HÀ

Connecting oceans, reaching the world — the guiding vision behind MAI KỲ HÀ's seafood trading, import and export business in Da Nang.

Clear communication,
partnerships built around your needs

MAI KỲ HÀ welcomes seafood buying and selling inquiries based on the product, specifications, quantity and trading terms. We clarify the details needed to discuss a suitable approach with each partner.

Our range includes tuna, scad, Indian mackerel, horse mackerel, other fish and black squid.

OUR PARTNERSHIP APPROACH

Connecting oceans,
reaching the world

Our slogan expresses the ambition to bring Vietnamese seafood closer to international markets. MAI KỲ HÀ pursues this vision through attention to product quality, clear communication and long-term partnerships.

01

Focused on seafood

Our fish and squid range serves trading, distribution and processing needs. Product form, processing and packaging are discussed for each order.

02

A focus on quality

Freshness, appearance and storage conditions should be clarified alongside the specifications. Actual product photos provide an additional reference for discussions.

03

Long-term connections

Agree on contacts, requirements and milestones to coordinate throughout the transaction.
